name: Aisha
contribution: The third and youngest wife of Islamic prophet Muhammad.

checks.lead: Aisha bint Abi Bakr (c. 614 CE – July 678) was the third and youngest wife of Islamic prophet Muhammad. After Muhammad's death, she was politically active during the Rashidun Caliphate and stands out as a prominent female figure of the period.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
